description: Book one visit for the customer, as a request the business approves (or, for a business that takes its bookings by email, confirms with the customer itself); the answer says what happens next and gives a `manage.token` to check or cancel it later. The customer is emailed. A new customer books the Meet & Greet first. Ask the customer about the dogs and answer from what they said (booking.petCare on the card): never guess. Confirm the visit, the time and the customer's details with the customer before calling it. `idempotency_key` is required: choose a new random one for each booking (a UUID without hyphens) and send the same one to retry after a timeout.

inputSchema.description: Book one visit. Every booking is a request the business approves. The same checks as the business's own booking form: a real open start, the customer's details and what they said about the dogs.

agent.description: Who is booking, so the business sees that an agent made the booking and which one.

acting_for.description: Optional: the person it acts for, if that is not the customer.

answers.description: What the customer told you about the visit and the dogs. The card's booking.petCare.answers says each key's exact format. Never guess: a question nobody asked is null.

addons.description: Optional: add-ons offered with the service (its note on the card says which). The extra dog is added by the business, never sent.

address.description: The dog's home address, or where the dog is picked up, as one line. Check it first (POST /agent/address, the MCP tool check_address) and send the `address` it answers.

address_confirmed.description: True when Google could not confirm the address, or corrected it, and the customer says theirs is right as they gave it: it is filed as given, for the business to check.

behavior.description: Whether any of the dogs has shown reactivity (to other dogs, to people, on the leash) or has a bite history. Asked: disclosed true and has_concerns the answer. Not asked: disclosed false and has_concerns null.

claims_prior_meet_greet.description: True only when the customer says they have already had a Meet & Greet with this business. A customer who has not books the Meet & Greet first: any other service is refused with `meet_greet_required`.

dogs.description: The dogs, 1 to 6 (fewer where a service says so).

items.description: One dog, with every key present. A yes-or-no question nobody asked is null, never false.

age_text.description: As the customer says it ("3 years", "8 months").

behavior_flags.description: What the customer says about this dog, as keys of the card's booking.petCare.behaviorFlags; [] for none. A flag is read even when behavior.has_concerns is false.

behavior_notes.description: The customer's own words about behaviour.

medical_notes.description: The customer's own words about health and medication.

name.description: The dog's name; each dog's own.

vaccinated_self_reported.description: What the customer says; null: not asked.

interested_services.description: On the Meet & Greet only, and required there: the services wanted afterwards, by family (the card's booking.petCare.interestedServices).

recurrence.description: Optional, on a service that can repeat (a walk): a weekly preference the business reads. Nothing repeats on its own.

customer.description: The person the booking is for. They are emailed that the request was received, and again when the business answers.

phone.description: A phone number the business can call: 10 to 15 digits ("(619) 555-0123").

idempotency_key.description: Required. A key you choose, new for each booking: 32 to 255 letters, digits, dashes or underscores, and RANDOM, never a counter, a word or a pattern (a UUID without hyphens is right; a key with fewer than 8 distinct characters is refused). Calling book again with the same key and customer email answers the first booking again, with the same manage token, instead of making a second one: use it to retry safely after a timeout.

items.description: Exactly one visit. Each visit is booked on its own; add-ons the service takes go in answers.addons.
The visit being booked: the `slug` of a service from the business card whose `bookable` is true.

quantity.description: 1, or left out: one visit, however many dogs (they go in answers.dogs).

slug.description: The service's slug, from the card's services list.

start.description: A start time from `times`, ISO 8601 with an offset, on a whole minute: seconds, when written, are 00 ("2026-10-12T10:00:00-07:00" or "2026-10-12T17:00Z"). It is checked again, and refused with `time_not_open` if it is no longer open.
